paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption: The character distribution in RoleplayPref consists of 3 primary categories and 13 subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представлява кръгова диаграма, която показва разпределението на различни категории персонажи в базата данни RoleplayPref. Диаграмата включва общо 13 сектори, които са категоризирани в три основни групи: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Custom Characters. Сектор на име "Movie Characters" е оцветен в син цвят и заема най-голяма част от кръга. Секторът "Custom Characters" е оцветен в зелен цвят и се намира в горната част на диаграмата.  До "Custom Characters" има сектори, наречени "Scientists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", "Influencers", "Virtual Characters", "Game Characters", "Novel Characters", "Teleplay Characters" и "Comic Characters", всеки от които е оцветен в различни цветове.  Вътре в различните сектори не е включена информация за проценти или дялове, но секторите "Movie Characters " и "Custom Characters" изглеждават визуално по-големи от останалите. Диаграмата включва легенда, която асоциира всеки сектор с неговото специфично име.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of character categories within the RoleplayPref dataset. There are thirteen slices representing distinct categories. The largest slice, colored teal, represents “Comic Characters,” occupying approximately 30% of the total area. The next largest slice, colored light blue, indicates “Movie Characters,” representing roughly 25%. A slice colored light green demonstrates “Custom Characters,” around 15%. Following this, there is a slice colored pink representing “Virtual Characters,” approximately 10%. Further slices, colored yellow, orange, purple, and gray, depict “Teleplay Characters,” “Novel Characters,” “Game Characters,” “Scientists”, “Athletes”, “Writers”, “Musicians”, “Actors”, “Influencers”, “Real Characters”, and “Dream Characters”, respectively, each occupying a smaller proportion of the total. The chart does not include a legend or percentage labels within the slices, but the slices appear to be ordered in a clockwise direction, beginning with the largest segment.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Kreisdiagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Charakteren in der Rolleprepf-Datenmenge. Es verfügt über 13 Segmente, die verschiedene Kategorien von Charakteren darstellen, darunter Comic-Charaktere (pink), Künstler (hellpink), Film-Charaktere (blau), benutzerdefinierte Charaktere (hellblau), Wissenschaftler (grün), Athleten (gelb), Schriftsteller (olivgrün), Musiker (olivgrün), Telepath-Charaktere (grau), Roman-Charaktere (lila), Spiel-Charaktere (lila), echte Charaktere (dunkelgrün), Schauspieler (dunkelgrün) und Influencer (dunkelgrün). Alle Segmente haben Prozentwerte angegeben. Die Segmente sind nach Größe angeordnet, wobei die größten Segmente Comic-Charaktere und die kleinsten Menschen und Influencer sind.
